# SI051 — time-or-random-in-compared-value

Timestamps and random values must stay out of the compared object.

## Why

Validators execute at different times; a timestamp can never be equal across them.

## Bad

```python
return {"verdict": v, "ruled_at": gl.block.timestamp}
```

## Good

```python
return {"verdict": v, "severity": s, "confidence": c, "clauses": []}
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI051 -- reason
```
